dataScope: Synthetic fixtures and temporary directories only; installed user library was not opened
persistenceChecks: Actual child _exit during migration and multi-row WAL transaction, fresh reopen, and successful subsequent save
Two simultaneous first-launch processes serialize schema and backup publication
Copied version-1 JSON, byte-identical immutable backup, repeated and interrupted migration, restart
Reading position: exactly one encoded document payload row, no previous images or catalogs encoded
Message edit and composer draft: exactly one appropriate payload row
No-op save: zero encoding, payload writes, position writes, or revision commit
Reordering: explicit position updates without re-encoding unchanged payloads
Rollback and retry preserve all-or-nothing multi-row state
Stale process rejection and export without rebasing expected revision
Unicode and embedded-NUL identifiers are preserved without truncating or merging rows
Duplicate IDs within one owner rejected; IDs reused across separate owners preserved
Course cascade deletion, independent roots and Canvas account metadata preservation
Unsupported schema rejected by fresh and already-open stores without stale JSON fallback
independentReviewChecks: Ordered draft writes, in-flight tombstones, recovery, retry, flush and per-document failure isolation
Recent-reading bounded selection matches a full-sort reference across limits and ties
Metadata cache invalidation for favorites, terms, names, removals and locale changes
Complete assignment pagination and nearest-deadline preview
Streamed content, drafts and download status do not rebuild dashboard or assignment projections
Canvas eligibility observation, assignment filter transfer and failed-save visibility after successful draft backup

measurements.measurementUnits: Encoded JSON payload bytes and changed payload rows; SQLite page/WAL bytes and separate revision update are not included in those work counters
